title: Agree one section/tab information architecture for the configEditor frames
question: Nineteen-plus config frames (Reschedule, Exchange, Upgrade, Downgrade, Convert, Ownership Transfer, Approval, Wallet, Physical Media, Delivery, Version History, Association, Draft & Edit, AI Recommendations, Resource Creation, Forecast Adjustment...) each declare their own tab list. Do we run one IA pass that fixes the standard section set for the configEditor pattern and bind each section to the contract view that fills it, or does every frame keep a bespoke tab list?
why_it_matters: Each frame is currently a separate screen-spec argument; one IA ruling closes all of them and stops nineteen inconsistent editors being built.

title: Extend DashboardTile.visualisation or state what the platform refuses to draw
question: DashboardTile.visualisation holds eight marks; the board packs ask for combo, matrix/pivot, funnel, waterfall, treemap, scatter/bubble, map, ribbon/rank, cohort and narrative text. Which marks join the enum, which are refused, and for each accepted mark, how do report columns bind to its axes, size and colour?
why_it_matters: Every dashboard in the source packs is drawn with marks the contract cannot express, so no analytics screen can be built or accepted until the enum is closed.

title: Decide whether a catalogue is a first-class object and how channels bind to it
question: Is a catalogue/assortment an object with a name, type (Global, Park, Seasonal, Event, Segment), a scope (all stores, store group, VIP stores) and a status (Draft, Scheduled, Published), that channels, outlets, price books and inventory sources point at - or does it stay a published per-venue bundle with the named catalogues as saved filters?
why_it_matters: The catalog board, the assortment builder and the sales-channel configuration table all sit on this one object; until it is settled twelve screens have nothing to bind to.

title: Extend ApprovalKind to the acts the screens gate, and set their matrix rules
question: ApprovalKind is closed and does not carry check-in/out correction, complimentary F&B, stock adjustment, stock transfer, inventory reopen after operational cancellation or manual void, manual entitlement activation, purchase order, supplier contract, supplier approval, budget, overtime, resource override or shift swap. Which of these become ApprovalKind values, and what role, level and amount band does each take on the ApprovalMatrix?
why_it_matters: Every 'requires approval' toggle on the screens is unbuildable and untestable until the kind exists and its matrix rule is named.
modules: Inventory, Access Control, F&B, Ticketing, Procurement, Governance

title: Type the stock location hierarchy: capacity, temperature class, utilisation and bins
question: Decide what a StockLocation carries - capacity and its unit (units, m3, pallet positions, kilograms), volume, temperature class and range (reuse fnb.TemperatureCheckpoint.kind or a new set; free-text spec or min/max Celsius), contact and address - which LocationKind members represent zones, bins and pick faces and receiving docks, and whether utilisation is stored or derived from StockPosition.
why_it_matters: Warehouse, zone, bin and utilisation screens all read fields that do not exist, and cold-chain rules cannot be written without a temperature class.

title: Decide whether supplier compliance documents are their own register
question: Do supplier documents become a table (type from Legal, Tax, Certification, Insurance, Financial; required/received/status; expiry and re-verification) or an extension of inventory.supplier_contract? Fix the mandatory onboarding list (trade licence, tax registration, HACCP, Halal, bank details, insurance), which are conditional on category, the per-document status vocabulary and the expiring-soon window.
why_it_matters: The compliance screen, the onboarding checklist, the compliance summary and the critical expired-certificate alert all hang off a model that does not exist.

title: Define the stock-health measure, its inputs and its band thresholds
question: Nine screens show stock health as Healthy/Warning/Critical, Healthy/At Risk/Critical/Overstock, Low/Healthy/Critical or a 0-100 score. What does stock health measure (days of cover, distance to reorder point, par level, expiry, value-weighted or count-weighted), what are the two or three band boundaries, and is there one vocabulary for F&B, retail stores and warehouses or three?
why_it_matters: Six modules would each invent their own formula and bands, so two screens would report a different health for the same outlet on the same day.
modules: F&B, Inventory, Planning, Retail, POS & Sales

title: Express the staff-to-participant ratio once, so sale-time capacity and roster cover agree
question: Capacity is shown as 1 instructor per 8 participants and staffing rules as participant bands 1-8, 9-16, 17-24 mapping to 1..5 instructors. Fix one expression (denominator, per-position rate, rounding, minimum floor, minimum level), decide the capacity-model enum around it (fixedQuantity, ratioBased, tiered, capacityBased, customFormula), what the participant count is sourced from, and the read that returns derived sellable capacity.
why_it_matters: Catalogue sells against one reading of the ratio and workforce rosters against another; if they differ the venue oversells a session it cannot staff.

title: Type Outlet.openingHours and decide the closure/exception record
question: Outlet.openingHours is an untyped array of object. Name the per-day element (day key, open time, close time, trading status, overnight allowed) and decide whether dated exceptions, holidays, breaks and closures are the same record with an Override/Closed status or a separate collection, and which scope level owns it.
why_it_matters: F&B outlets and retail stores are both blocked on the same untyped field, and price lists, channels and ordering windows all key off it.

title: Define the expiry formula builder, or refuse an expression language
question: The Dynamic Expiry frame asks for a formula builder with Days/Hours/Months, If/Then and brackets, evaluated against guest attributes, with validation, a named input list, a fallback rule and a plain-language explanation. Does expiry become an expression language at all - and if so, the grammar, operator set, precedence, the closed list of readable inputs, where expressions are stored and versioned, and what a valid expression is?
why_it_matters: An expression language stored against entitlements has security, testability and migration consequences that cannot be unwound once tickets are issued against it.

title: Define the policy register: the named policy set, and per policy its owner, version, status and effective date
question: Governance ships eight resource policies (staff replacement, overtime, resource priority, maintenance blocking, rental and deposit, customer selection, AI autonomy, override governance) and Ticketing names service policies (Group Policy owned by Sales Ops, Corporate Policy owned by Corporate Sales) plus an association register. Is there one policy record (name, area, scope, status, version, owner, effective date, expiry or review date) reusing the white-label Policy shape, or a policy per area?
why_it_matters: The policy hub, its Expiring Soon tile and the association table all read owner, version and status fields that no schema carries.

title: Define the store/outlet template entity and the capability switches it sets
question: Seven screens describe templates (Quick-Service Restaurant, Full Retail Store, Retail Kiosk, Mobile Cart) that toggle counter order, kitchen, KDS, modifiers, reservations, inventory, returns, loyalty, click-and-collect and tender types. Is a template a first-class object with a usage count, platform-seeded or tenant-created - and do retail sub-types (gift shop, merchandise store, souvenir shop) extend OutletKind or become a template attribute beneath kind 'shop'?
why_it_matters: BO-730 has no createTemplate operation and every store would otherwise be configured field by field, with no way to report which outlets share a configuration.

title: Fix the SuggestionKind catalogue and the rule and payload behind each recommendation
question: Seven screens show AI recommendations the enum does not carry: resource optimisation moves, asset replacement, clearance/markdown for slow stock, collection-inventory markdown, inter-location transfer with avoided lost sales, conversion-rate-versus-yesterday and average-ticket-value commentary. Which become SuggestionKind values, what rule produces each, and what does its value payload hold?
why_it_matters: Each panel shows a number (estimated saving, lost sales avoided) that nothing computes, so the recommendation cannot be reproduced or tested.
modules: Reporting/BI, Frontline Operations, Events, Inventory, Promotions

title: Decide the temporary capacity override entity and its expiry
question: Define the override: its scope, the override type set (increase, decrease, suspend sale, emergency close), its own effective-from/to window, whether it is stored on the envelope or as a separate record, its approval kind, whether supporting evidence may be attached, what value it reverts to on automatic expiry and what happens if the reverted capacity is already oversold.
why_it_matters: An emergency capacity change with no expiry and no revert value is an operational risk that leaves the envelope permanently wrong.

title: Define kitchen station capacity, the load formula and its bands
question: Station cards and tables show Queue, Avg Prep, Target, Utilization, SLA, a Kitchen Load percentage with a High qualifier and a High Load / Normal classification. KitchenStation carries no capacity, target or load field. Decide the capacity unit (covers, items or minutes), the load and utilisation formulas, the per-station prep target, the band thresholds, and whether the classification is stored or computed per read.
why_it_matters: Six kitchen surfaces quote a load percentage and a utilisation that nothing defines, and station capacity is also the input a capacity-aware routing rule needs.

title: Define the procurement savings measure and its baseline
question: Six procurement screens quote savings (total sourcing savings, savings % of spend, savings by category, savings by supplier, potential savings over 90 days). What is the baseline - last price paid, quoted versus awarded, contract price or budget - over what scope and period, and is it a KpiDefinition over the semantic model or a field on the suggestion payload?
why_it_matters: Savings is the headline number on the sourcing board and nothing in the build computes it, so the tile, the trend, the category cut and the supplier cut are all unbuildable and untestable.

title: Give the stock adjustment a status vocabulary and a reason-code set
question: StockMovement has no status and its reason is free text. Decide the adjustment status vocabulary (Pending/Posted/Approved) with who posts and whether stock moves before or after, and fix the reason-code list (expired, damaged, count variance, transfer correction, lost in transit, shrinkage, lost, sample, quantity difference, wrong location) - one list or separate F&B, retail and count-variance lists, fixed enum or venue-configurable reference data.
why_it_matters: Adjustment screens, the pending/posted tabs and the variance-by-reason chart cannot be built, and no variance report can be reconciled across modules while the reason is free text.

title: Add the missing canvas, grid and stepping components to the component library
question: screens/_components.yaml has no calendar/scheduling grid, no floor-plan canvas with viewport controls, no drag-and-drop layout canvas and no previous/next record stepper. Decide which component kinds are added and their specs - time-axis granularity, current-time indicator, overlapping-block stacking, zoom/reset/full-screen controls, what a floor-plan heatmap encodes, whether the POS builder reuses the page builder's canvas, and how record stepping works under cursor pagination.
why_it_matters: Five screens across four modules specify surfaces the closed component list cannot express, so each would be built one-off.
modules: F&B, Calendar, POS Experience & Sales Configuration, Staff

title: Decide the cash-limit set and where each limit is configured
question: Fix the cash limits - per-till drawer ceiling, safe-drop trigger amount, maximum cash in/out per movement, drawer rules (auto-open tenders, forced count, no-sale cap) - the scope each is set at (venue, workstation or till), whether they live on VenueSettings or a new shift-policy object, and whether a breach warns, blocks the sale or forces a safe drop.
why_it_matters: Neither VenueSettings nor shift.yaml carries a cash field, so 'enforce cash limits' cannot be implemented and a cashier cannot be told why a sale was refused.

title: Decide whether resource matching returns a numeric score, and what it scores
question: Five screens show a percentage match, a rank and a Sorted-by-Match control, while suggestResources deliberately returns attribute matches with no score and the 26 August decision ruled out AI matching. Either define the score (its inputs, weights and how it is explained, following matchGuest's score-plus-matchedOn precedent) or replace the percentage on the screens with the matched attributes that already exist.
why_it_matters: Either every staff, resource and alternative-item picker shows a number nothing computes, or five screens must be redrawn - and the two answers cost very differently.

title: Decide whether the multi-day use pattern is consecutive or flexible, and what a skipped day does
question: For multi-day and number-of-days products, must usage days run consecutively from first scan or may they be spread within a longer validity window; is it set per entitlement template or per venue; is a skipped day forfeited, rolled forward or does it extend validTo; and does a partial day count as a full day (calendar-day consumption versus rolling 24 hours)?
why_it_matters: Scan-time enforcement against entriesUsed and lastEntryAt cannot be written, and the guest-facing promise differs materially between the two answers.

title: Fix the closed sales-channel vocabulary and use it in every subsystem
question: catalogue.Channel, fnb.publishMenu.channels (untyped), fnb.GuestOrderingMethod and the retail revenue split disagree. Settle one channel list - does POS split into Store POS and Mobile POS, is QR ordering a channel or an ordering method, are Guest App and B2C Web distinct from mobile and web, is the Corporate Portal its own channel or b2b under a corporate account - and type every channel field against it.
why_it_matters: Sales-by-channel is reported three different ways today; two boards would total the same day's revenue into different buckets.

title: Fix the custom-attribute registry: its data types and its per-attribute flags
question: Attribute tables across CRM, catalogue, inventory categories and resources show Data Type (Number, Pick List, Boolean, Reference, Text), Required, Unique, Searchable, Reportable, API Exposed and Channel Visible. Fix the data-type enum (and what a Reference points at and how it is validated) and decide which flags are stored per attribute rather than deployment decisions - in particular whether per-field uniqueness is a flag or only expressible by promoting the field into the identifiers list.
why_it_matters: Four modules would each build their own attribute registry, and a uniqueness collision at guest checkout has no defined behaviour.
build_artefact: docs/architecture/data-model.md:25-33 (data mask field-definition registry); contracts/satellite/resources.yaml:2309 ResourceAttributeDefinition

title: Fix the supplier onboarding case and its stages
question: Does a supplier have an onboarding case with stages (Request, Evaluation, Onboarding, Approval, Active) and the stepper stages (Basic Information, Documents, Bank Details, Category Mapping, Approval)? Fix its field list (supplier, category, country, requested on, requested by, status), who owns each stage, which stages gate transacting, how it relates to Supplier.isActive, what onboarding progress is measured against, the onboarding ApprovalKind and how a document request reaches the supplier.
why_it_matters: Two onboarding screens describe different stage lists and neither has a record to write to.

title: Name the non-POS roles and bind them to existing permission keys
question: roles.yaml carries six POS roles. Name the BI persona set (executive/viewer, operations manager, analyst, dashboard designer, platform administrator) and the event-management roles (at minimum Event Manager), bind each to the existing REPORT_VIEW_WORKSTATION / REPORT_VIEW_VENUE / REPORT_VIEW_TENANT / REPORT_EXPORT / REPORT_SCHEDULE / REPORT_MANAGE tiers, and say whether they are cumulative with venueManager.
why_it_matters: Five screens identify a signed-in user by a role that does not exist, so no permission test can be written for the analytics or event boards.

title: Pin the workstation Type/Mode enum and bind venueKindScope to it
question: Fix the closed workstation type set - Fixed Counter, Mobile/Flying POS, Self-Service Kiosk, Kitchen Display, Temporary/Event, Web POS - decide which schema owns it, and make ConfigurationProfile.venueKindScope reference it rather than free text.
why_it_matters: Five dashboards count workstations by a type that is free text today, so two screens can report different totals for the same estate.
modules: Workstation Management, POS, POS Configuration, Retail

title: Set the kitchen SLA targets, the escalation ladder and the firing vocabulary
question: Decide whether SLA targets are per category as well as per service mode and set target/warning/delayed per category; fix the escalation ladder percentages (Monitor 70%, Warning 80%, Delayed 100%, Supervisor 120%, Manager) with a recipient and action at each step and whether it is outlet-configurable; fix the ticket firing-state vocabulary including Partially Fired and the near-SLA threshold; and decide whether a hold stamps heldAt and pauses the SLA clock.
why_it_matters: setKitchenSla carries a single warnAtPercent, so the KDS, the escalation rules and the near-SLA badge are all reading a ladder that does not exist.

title: Decide whether inventory documents carry an explicit priority
question: Requisitions, replenishment suggestions, transfers and counts all show a High/Medium/Low priority the schemas do not carry. Is priority explicit or derived from requiredBy and daysOfCoverRemaining against leadTimeDays; what does each level change (routing, approval route, fulfilment order); and add the corresponding list filters.
why_it_matters: Five list screens filter and sort on a field that does not exist, and an approval route that reads priority cannot be configured.

title: Decide how a device, workstation or rental station is placed on a map
question: Is a workstation, device or rental booth placed by adding a point kind to the venue-map's closed VenuePoint set and linking it, or by coordinates on DeviceAssignment/Workstation? Decide what a point carries (coordinates, floor, status colour), at what zoom the estate view resolves, and whether the operational live map is the same surface as the guest map.
why_it_matters: Four map screens across device, workstation and rental management would otherwise each invent their own placement model.
modules: Workstation Management, Workstation & Device Management, Device Management, Rental Management

title: Decide the inventory reopen rules after a cancellation
question: Is release-versus-hold configurable when a booking is cancelled, refunded, rescheduled, no-showed, operationally cancelled or manually voided - at what scope and on which record? Fix the event-type vocabulary, the reopen behaviours (immediate / after a window / manual), the no-show window duration and whether released units go to general sale or back to a channel.
why_it_matters: Whether a cancelled slot returns to sale decides realisable revenue, and today nothing states it for any of the six events.

title: Decide the membership lifecycle: proration, dunning suspension, cancellation timing and grace access
question: Are mid-term upgrades and downgrades prorated, on what basis (daily, monthly, unused entitlement) and does the credit go to the wallet or the original tender; does a failed recurring payment ever suspend access automatically and after how many days; does member-initiated cancellation take effect immediately or at end of term with what refund; and what does Limited Access mean during a renewal grace period?
why_it_matters: payments.yaml deliberately reserves suspension as 'a staff decision with a name attached to it', so an automatic 7-day suspension would contradict the build.

title: Decide the till variance tolerance, its reason codes and the float status vocabulary
question: Where does the over/short tolerance live (till, workstation or venue), is it a percentage or an amount and who may change it; is an expected opening float held per till and compared to the counted opening; what are the status values (Balanced/Over/Short) at open as well as close; and what is the cash variance reason-code set (till error, unrecorded refund, miscount, other) - venue-maintained or fixed, with or without a mandatory comment?
why_it_matters: acceptShiftVariance quotes 'the configured threshold' that nothing stores, and the opening-float screen shows a status the build only computes at close.

title: Decide what a shift template holds and where the attendance thresholds live
question: Fix the shift template contents (pattern, applicable days, effective dates, break rule, float, tolerance, approval) and whether it is a workforce entity or venue settings; set the minutes for grace period, flexible start window, late arrival and early leave thresholds and whether they sit on StaffingRules (venue) or ShiftTemplate (per template); and decide what happens to published assignments when a template's dates change.
why_it_matters: AttendanceRecord.exception late/earlyLeave has no defined boundary, so lateness cannot be computed or tested.
modules: Shift & Operator Management, POS, Shift Management

title: Decide what defaults a category carries and how items inherit them
question: Does a category carry defaults that new items inherit (default UOM, default tracking, default valuation method, enabled/disabled status), accounting mappings and warehouse defaults, and a free-text description (localised or not)? And is Item Type (F&B ingredient, retail merchandise, consumable, operating supply, spare part) a distinct field or expressed through the category tree - given costingMethod is immutable once movements exist?
why_it_matters: An inherited valuation method that conflicts with an immutable costingMethod would corrupt stock valuation the first time it is applied.

title: Decide whether a Promotion Group is a record, and whether it is versioned
question: Is a named Promotion Group with an owner, a version and an effective date the thing products associate to, or is stackingGroup plus a product-level allow-list already that concept? If it is a record, may a product hold several groups, how do two groups conflict, does its expiry raise an alert and at what lead time, and what does a version change do to live carts?
why_it_matters: Four promotion screens reference a group by name and version, and nothing in promotions.yaml carries either.

title: Decide whether a session/timeslot template is versioned and how widely it applies
question: Does a session template carry a description (length, multilingual), a status and a version number that joins product versioning; may it target many attractions as removable chips or is it cloned per attraction and how does an edit propagate; and is a Minimum Capacity a generation constraint, a publication guard or both, with what happening to slots already below it?
why_it_matters: A template edit that silently rewrites performances already generated and sold against is unrecoverable.

title: Decide whether a variant dimension may hold capacity as well as price
question: Guest Category, Admission Tier and Service Level are described as dimensions that affect both pricing and capacity, while the contract says a dimension may not hold capacity. Can a dimension draw on its own capacity envelope or does capacity stay at performance and channel level only - and does a dimension carry an active/retired status distinct from its variants?
why_it_matters: If a tier holds its own envelope the whole capacity model changes; if not, three configuration screens are promising something the platform will refuse.

title: Decide whether an RFQ evaluation is its own record, and fix its criteria and weights
question: Is an evaluation a record (scoring sheet, notes, history) or a projection over quotations? Fix the criteria set (Price, Quality, Delivery, Service, Compliance), whether weights are per RFQ or per category and must total 100, the scoring scale, who may edit weights, what Share Evaluation means (recipients, format, permission) and whether a shortlist is a stored state on the quotation or a transient selection.
why_it_matters: The comparison screen's tabs, its weights and its Shortlist and Recommend Award actions have nothing to persist to.

title: Decide whether connectivity has a third 'weak' band and what it permits
question: ConnectivityPolicy is binary. Is there a weak-connection state - who measures signal strength, on which device classes, what thresholds enter and leave it, what does it permit that offline does not, and is probe latency retained per workstation at what resolution and does it drive anything beyond the online/offline decision?
why_it_matters: Four screens legend pins and toggles by Strong/Weak/Offline against a policy that knows only two states.
modules: Offline Operations, Workstation Management, Offline POS & Synchronization

title: Decide whether units of measure become a first-class register
question: Do UOMs become a register (code, name, type, base unit, conversion factor, status) or stay free-text strings on the item? Fix the seeded list (PCS, KG, G, L, ML, BOX, CTN, PAL) and whether tenants may add to it, the unit-type classification (each, weight, volume) and what behaviour depends on it, and whether displayed decimal places and rounding method are per-unit configuration or fixed by the numeric(18,4) column.
why_it_matters: Conversions and sell-by-weight rules cannot be implemented against free-text units, and rounding differences would show up as stock variance.

title: Define the count and reconciliation accuracy percentage - one formula
question: Fix the inventory accuracy measure: numerator and denominator (lines within tolerance, quantity accuracy or valued accuracy; by line or by value over StockCount.varianceLineCount and lineCount), its period and grain, whether history is stored as a KPI value series or recomputed from counts, and register it in MetricSource so the MTD tile, the summary panel and both trend charts quote the same number.
why_it_matters: Four tiles and trends on two screens would each compute accuracy differently, so the same month would report two accuracies.

title: Define the order routing rule record and its precedence
question: Define the routing rule schema fnb.yaml does not have: which attributes are matchable (category, outlet, service type, time of day, station capacity), whether conditions combine with AND only, an explicit order integer and an isActive flag following approvals.ApprovalRule.order, the precedence Product > Category > Outlet > Kitchen Default, what happens when two rules at the same level match, and what the Auto Routing toggle switches and where it lives.
why_it_matters: BO-135's columns are bound to Workstation because no rule object exists; nothing routes an order to a station today.
build_artefact: screens/P08-venue-back-office.yaml:27339 BO-135; contracts/satellite/fnb.yaml (no routing rule schema)

title: Define the resource health score and the utilisation bands
question: Define the Resource Health Score out of 100 - which measures feed it, with what weights, the band boundaries behind Excellent and the week-over-week baseline - and fix the utilisation bands used by the calendar (Low 0-30, Medium 31-60, High 61-80, Very High 81-100, Unavailable) and by the analytics screen (under- and over-utilised), whether they vary by resource type and whether they are venue-configurable KpiTargets or fixed platform-wide. Then reconcile the Resource Health donut vocabulary (Fully Resourced, At Risk, Underutilized, Overutilized, Unavailable) with Resource.status.
why_it_matters: ResourceUtilisation carries a percentage and no composite score or bands, so the gauge, the donut and the colour-coded calendar each invent their own cut.

title: Define the retail fulfilment state machine and its SLA
question: Do Picking, Packed, Ready, Dispatched and Accepted join a retail order status enum or extend ShopAndDrop/MerchandiseReservation, and which statuses roll up into the Ready tab? Fix the fulfilment-type facet (collect, deliver, in-store), the target minutes per fulfilment type, where the promised-by time is stamped, and the warn percentage before breach.
why_it_matters: The order table, its counted tabs and its SLA countdown have no status enum, no promise time and no target to count down to.

title: Fix the channel capacity and allocation model vocabularies
question: Define the sales Capacity Models (Fixed, Unlimited, Pooled, Derived), the Allocation Models (Fixed, Dynamic/Derived, Shared Pool) and the association types (Pooled, Nested, Exclusive, Shared Across Channels) - in particular what a Derived capacity derives from and how often it recomputes, how Unlimited is represented against an integer envelope, what Nested means for a pool inside a pool, whether Exclusive blocks the general-pool fallback, and whether an allocation may be scoped to a promotion or event and carry a hold state.
why_it_matters: ChannelAllocation has neither a scope discriminator nor a status, so the allocation board cannot be built and two subsystems would read a pooled allocation differently.

title: Fix the planning exception record, its classes, priority and AED impact
question: Fix the planning exception vocabulary (Stockout Risk, Below Safety Stock, High Variance, Slow Moving Items, No Forecast, Other) and the rule that puts an item into each class; decide whether it is a persisted row or a derived view; how AED impact is computed; and whether its priority reuses Alert.severity rather than introducing a second three-level scale.
why_it_matters: The exception donut, the Top Exceptions table and the Review action all aggregate over an object that does not exist.

title: Make the calendar Conflict a first-class record with a severity scale
question: Does a Conflict become a schema (type, resource, window, human-readable detail, severity, available actions) with an operation that lists it, or stay a calendar state? Decide the severity scale (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and what assigns it, whether the detail sentence is generated or stored, and the resolution option set (replace, move, reassign) with what a supporting reason, an impact statement and a not-recommended flag contain.
why_it_matters: The Conflict Center, its severity tabs and the conflict assistant have no operation to call and no object to count.

title: Register the P08 boards and the navigation rail
question: Define the P08 navigationSet - the item list and order (Dashboard, Calendar, Resources, Staff, Bookings, Assignments, Events, Rentals, Requests, Reports, Settings), which module each item requires and whether the rail collapses - decide whether the back office gains numbered boards at all, settle one caption for the planning entry ('Planning & Analytics' or 'Planning & Forecasting'), and name the ten screens that compose it.
why_it_matters: Two packs give the same board two captions and the screens are unregistered, so the navigation cannot be built or reviewed.

title: Decide whether DashboardTile carries per-mark display settings
question: The packs ask for zoom and missing-value behaviour on line/area, a secondary axis with stated units on combo, a category limit with an Other bucket on pie/donut, and point labels with zoom on scatter. Does DashboardTile.parameters carry per-mark display options - and if so which, with what defaults - or are these fixed runtime behaviours and where are units declared?
why_it_matters: Missing-value handling alone changes what a chart asserts; leaving it undeclared means two tiles on the same data tell different stories.

title: Decide how a temporary or event selling location is modelled
question: Is an event or pop-up store an Outlet with effective dates, a new OutletKind value, a LocationKind with an event reference and a close-out date, or a workstation-only concept? Decide what happens to its stock and price list when the period ends, how it reports alongside permanent outlets, and the alert threshold for units still at a temporary location after event closure.
why_it_matters: Three screens list an Event Merchandise Store beside permanent stores with no way to distinguish or close it, leaving stranded stock unaccounted for.

title: Decide how machine and system actors are attributed in audit trails
question: How is an automated actor represented - a reserved service principal, a bot flag, a nullable actor, or an actorKind discriminator - and is the originating source (Backend, AI Engine, Mobile, Integration, API, System/AI) a channel on the record or an actor kind? Apply the same answer to inventory.StockMovement.principalId (today required) and platform.audit_record.
why_it_matters: StockMovement.principalId is mandatory, so an Inventory Bot movement cannot be written at all without this ruling.

title: Decide the SKU identifier model: barcode symbology, RFID and EPC
question: Which barcode symbologies are supported (EAN-13, UPC-A, Code128), is the type per SKU or per tenant and what validation does each imply; is RFID a per-SKU flag, a per-item serialisation policy, or both, and what does a mixed tagged/untagged catalogue mean at the gate; and is the EPC stored on the SKU under a GTIN-derived scheme or per tagged item, in which encoding?
why_it_matters: ProductVariant.barcode is a bare string, so no scan can be validated and RFID gate reads have nothing to match against.

title: Decide the allocation scoring policy: its factor codes, weights and hard constraints
question: Fix the factor codes ResourceAllocationPolicy.scoringWeights accepts (skill match, availability, same venue, customer language, workload balance, overtime impact, cost optimisation, continuity), their priority order, how a hard constraint is expressed (a separate mandatory-factor list or a sentinel weight), agreed default weights for the soft factors, and the eligibility outcome set (qualified / qualified-with-warning / not-qualified) with which requirement kinds are hard rather than preferred.
why_it_matters: The policy cannot be tested and the Eligibility Preview counts cannot be produced until mandatory and weighted factors are distinguishable.

title: Decide the check-in/check-out session rules
question: What happens at max stay - auto-close the visit, deny the exit scan, raise an alert or charge - and who may override it; what does an exit scan with no open visit do (refuse, admit and log, or admit and open a correction); and may a scan record be corrected, what may be changed, is the original retained and how does the audit entry read?
why_it_matters: Three gate behaviours are named as configurable settings with no stated outcomes, so the reader at the gate cannot be implemented.

title: Decide the dashboard builder canvas and its binding model
question: Fix the canvas column count (the source asks for 12) and the responsive breakpoints at which it collapses; decide the canvas manipulation verb set (drag, resize, align, distribute, layer, lock, duplicate, group) and which verbs change DashboardTile.position rather than needing new tile fields; and fix the field-well vocabulary (Axis, Legend, Values, Small Multiples, Tooltips, Filters) and which wells each visualisation value accepts.
why_it_matters: Without a well-to-mark matrix the builder cannot validate a binding, so a user can compose a tile the runtime refuses to draw.

title: Decide the deferred best-available seat model
question: May an order line carry a section and quantity with no seat ids? When does internal allocation actually run, what does the guest's entitlement say in the meantime, when is the seat-level ticket or QR issued, may the venue reshuffle allocated seats before disclosure, and when are the seats written back to the order?
why_it_matters: Three screens describe a purchase path the order model cannot represent, and the answer decides whether seat inventory is held at sale or at disclosure.

title: Decide the reorder rule: method, review period, lead time and EOQ
question: Is a reorder method selectable (min/max, EOQ, periodic review) and which fields does each method need; is EOQ computed and from which inputs (holding cost, order cost, demand) or dropped; does the rule carry a review period and what runs on it; and where do lead time and approval attach?
why_it_matters: The reorder configuration screen offers four tabs of settings that no schema holds, and an EOQ with no inputs cannot be computed.

title: Decide the shared audit-record shape and what it retains
question: Which entities must carry an old-value/new-value trail, do logins and shift start/end join the same trail, does it become one shared schema rather than eight independent audit tables with no shared read, does the record carry originating IP and user agent against the PII-free logging position, and what are the search and filter parameters (resource, principal, action, subject reference, date range)?
why_it_matters: Eight separate audit tables cannot answer 'who changed this' across the platform, and an IP field contradicts the stated observability policy.

title: Decide the supplier discovery and classification attributes
question: Fix the supplier discovery attribute set - country/origin, capability or service tags, certification types held, minimum rating - whether capability is a fixed vocabulary or free tags, what the free-text search spans (name, category, country, capability), and how a supplier is classified local versus international (a country field or scope relative to the venue's jurisdiction).
why_it_matters: Two search screens filter on attributes the Supplier schema does not hold, and the local/international split on the network panel has no rule.

title: Decide what a sale-board tile can be and how it is hidden
question: Does SaleBoard tile kind extend to banner/image, dynamic list, search box, text/label and spacer, or are those chrome the builder does not place? Does a tile gain an isActive or visibility rule (by date, access right or area) or does hiding a button mean removing the tile? And is price display a per-tile flag, a per-board setting or a profile setting - and what does it show for a variant with several prices?
why_it_matters: The POS layout builder offers a component palette the tile model cannot express, so boards built in the designer would not render.
modules: POS Experience & Sales Configuration, POS Configuration

title: Decide what an entitlement/validity template records about itself
question: Does EntitlementTemplate carry effectiveFrom/effectiveTo, a responsible owner and a derived used-by count following Product.onSaleFrom and Product.responsibleDepartmentId, and do the same fields apply to the duplication-template library? Fix the validity-rule status set (Active, Draft, Retired, Expired) and whether it gets a states/ entry or whether isActive plus effective dating is enough.
why_it_matters: The validity rule library lists Status, Effective From/To, Used By and Owner columns that no schema carries.

title: Decide where the margin threshold lives and the cost basis for margin
question: Where is the margin target configured - a category default, a product override or a venue default - what is its value, and does cost come from the last purchase price or the item's costing method? The Low Margin Products tile must also state the threshold it used.
why_it_matters: A margin figure computed on two cost bases makes the low-margin count arguable and the tile untestable.

title: Decide whether first-use activation is its own event on the entitlement
question: Does first-use activation emit its own event and stamp an activatedAt distinct from the first access-validated scan; is manual activation an operation with its own permission and what does it set validFrom to; and does a failed or denied scan consume activation, with what shown to the operator when it does not?
why_it_matters: Rolling-validity products start their clock on activation, so an undefined activation moment makes every expiry date arguable.

title: Define lead time and booking cutoff: what each measures and where it is set
question: Distinguish the fields the screens use interchangeably - minimum advance lead time, last-minute cutoff, and the timeslot template's lead time in minutes. What does each measure from, in what unit (hours, days, next calendar day), is it per product, per performance, per channel or per product-channel pair, and is it evaluated in the venue's timezone or the guest's?
why_it_matters: Three surfaces would enforce different cutoffs on the same sale, and a guest refused on one channel would succeed on another.

title: Define offline exposure and what 'a venue is offline' means
question: Define offline exposure in AED: which unsynced records count, at what scope it aggregates (estate, venue, workstation), how it is refreshed, and whether it is a MetricSource value or a field on the offline monitor read. Then define 'a venue is offline' (share of workstations offline, edge node unreachable, both), its threshold and its recipients.
why_it_matters: OfflinePolicy's ceilings are controls, not a measure; the exposure figure on three dashboards has no source and no alert can be configured against it.

title: Define the POS/frontline exception record and its type taxonomy
question: Fix the frontline incident and exception type set (printer offline, payment failed, offline sync failed, cash drawer not closing, card reader offline, price override, item not found) - do they extend maintenance.IncidentKind or become a device/POS exception kind of their own, which contract owns each, what raises them, and what attribution does the record carry (workstation, department, sub-department, operator, severity, status)?
why_it_matters: maintenance.IncidentKind is a safety vocabulary (guest injury, near miss); three operations dashboards rank exception types that nothing records.

title: Define the forecast measures and where a forecast is persisted
question: Define forecast fill rate (numerator, denominator and window), forecast variance for an item (forecast against actual, over what window) with the 'high' threshold that raises a risk alert, and forecast accuracy - then decide where an inventory demand forecast is persisted (an ai.Suggestion snapshot or a forecast table), its grain and its retention period so a monthly trend can be drawn.
why_it_matters: None of the three measures exists in MetricSource and no forecast is stored, so accuracy cannot be computed retrospectively at all.

title: Define the impact field on ai.Suggestion and its band vocabulary
question: Define a structured estimated impact on ai.Suggestion and ai.ProposedAction - amount or delta, unit (currency, percentage points, minutes), basis and period - and decide whether a separate impact band (High/Medium/Low, or High/Medium/Low/Preventive) is carried as well, how the band is derived from the estimate, and whether it reuses AnalyticsAnomaly.severity.
why_it_matters: Three screens rank and total recommendations by impact; without a stated basis the totals are not reproducible and cannot be tested.

title: Define the scenario simulator: its library, parameters and comparison shape
question: Which predefined scenarios ship (attendance +20%, N instructors unavailable, main hall closure, add another event, reduce labour cost by 10%), what parameters does each expose, are custom scenarios saved rows or ad hoc; and fix the comparison result shape - the columns (current plan, scenario impact, AI optimized plan, difference), the metric list it runs over, whether the optimized plan is a stored Suggestion or recomputed per view, and whether price elasticity is computed and stored over what window.
why_it_matters: BO-931 has no content region and no bound columns, so the digital-twin screen cannot be started at all.

title: Fix the product content field set and its length limits
question: Decide the storefront content fields on Product (marketing title, short description with its 150-character limit, long description, guest instructions with its 500-character limit, terms, age limits, media asset ids), where each is authored, whether guest instructions sit on Product, EntitlementTemplate or a CMS content block, and whether publishing them is the catalogue publish or the white-label content publish.
why_it_matters: Website package detail is meant to sync automatically from these fields; without them the storefront and the back office hold different copy.

title: Fix the supplier performance scorecard formula and its bands
question: Decide how Responsiveness and Overall Compliance are measured, the weighting across the six criteria (on-time delivery, quality, price competitiveness, responsiveness, invoice accuracy, overall compliance), the 0-5 normalisation and the comparison period the trend arrow reads; set the band boundaries behind labels such as Excellent; and decide whether the supplier star rating is derived from getSupplierPerformance or entered by a buyer.
why_it_matters: A composite score with no formula cannot be recomputed, disputed or tested, and buyers would be blocking suppliers on it.

title: Fix the validity-window time semantics: inclusivity, DST and overnight
question: Are validTo and validTimeWindows.to inclusive or exclusive; is a validity window wall-clock or absolute across a DST change (is the duration or the local time preserved); and how is an overnight window expressed - a next-day flag or a to-time past 24:00 - and which calendar day the entitlement counts against?
why_it_matters: validateAccess and the reporting replica must agree to the second; if they do not, a guest admitted at the gate appears out of validity in the report.

title: Settle one severity scale across alerts, incidents and exception centres
question: Alert.severity and AlertRule.severity are info/warning/critical, maintenance carries a five-value IncidentSeverity, and matrix 22.9.6 and three dashboards use Critical/High/Medium/Low. Does operational severity move to the four-band scale, or do the dashboards group the existing three - and record the mapping either way, including what a transaction-exception severity means.
why_it_matters: Until one scale wins, an alert counted as Critical on one board is Warning on another and no alert test can be written.

title: Settle whether recipe depletion is real-time or end-of-day
question: Is recipe-based stock depletion deferred to end of day (which allows offline F&B sale) or real-time (which blocks it), is it a per-outlet setting or fixed platform behaviour, and if configurable, what is the setting called, at what level does it sit, and what does it do to the offline sale rule in ADR-0013?
why_it_matters: This is the only High-severity pair in the set: it decides whether an F&B outlet can sell while offline, and contradicts ADR-0013 either way.

title: Decide the ID-proof and guest attribute requirements a ticket may demand
question: Fix the ID-document vocabulary a ticket may require (Emirates ID, passport, handicap/PoD documentation, other), whether the number is format-validated and against what pattern, whether an image is uploaded and where it is retained, that these are configurable per entitlement template rather than fixed system behaviour, and that region is the scope level that overrides them.
why_it_matters: Retaining an identity document image is a data-protection decision that cannot be made by an implementer, and the UAE-resident ticket cannot be sold without it.

title: Decide the capacity forecast's input signals and safety bounds
question: Does staffing coverage feed the capacity forecast, with what banding (Adequate / Short / Critical) and what weight; and what are the forecast's safety bounds (minimum and maximum capacity), at what scope level, and is a proposal outside them refused or escalated?
why_it_matters: A forecast that can propose any capacity without bounds is an operational risk, and the staffing signal is the one input that ties it to the roster.

title: Decide the checkout donation prompt's placement and default state
question: Is the donation prompt's position in checkout configurable (before or after the payment section, on the confirmation step) and is it set per channel or per tenant; and is the prompt pre-selected by default, may that differ by channel or jurisdiction, and what is the recorded consent rationale?
why_it_matters: A pre-ticked donation is an opt-out that is unlawful in several markets, so the default cannot be left to the implementer.

title: Decide the count types and the cycle-count schedule
question: Do Freeze Count and Expiring Count join the count-kind enum and what does each imply (movement freezing, selection from expiring batches)? And fix cycle-count scheduling: the cadence per location or category, what creates the due date, and when a planned count becomes overdue.
why_it_matters: The overdue-count alert has no due date to measure against, and a freeze count that does not freeze movement produces a variance that is not real.

title: Decide the donation campaign association model
question: Which targets does a donation campaign bind to (product, category, ticket type, membership, package), are guest segments in scope, where do the association rows live, do associations carry exclusion lists, and what does a conflict between two overlapping campaigns on one product mean - is the promotions precedence/StackingMode mechanism reused or is a donation-specific rule written?
why_it_matters: Two campaigns on one product with no precedence rule means the prompt shown at checkout is non-deterministic.

title: Decide the kitchen and service alert trigger set and each threshold
question: Fix the live-alert triggers and thresholds for the kitchen board (station capacity percentage, SLA proximity, KDS heartbeat timeout, held-course age, collection wait) and for the restaurant service board (reservation grace period, table-over-expected-time limit, VIP arrival lead time, walk-in wait threshold).
why_it_matters: setAlertRule provides the mechanism only and the reservation grace period has no value, so nine alert conditions cannot be configured or tested.
build_artefact: contracts/satellite/reporting.yaml:195 setAlertRule; states/table-reservation.yaml (grace period has no value)

title: Decide the reach of the profile-linking model
question: When a CRM family unit and a family-ticket product disagree on composition or age bands, which side is authoritative and are the product's rules validated against the relationship graph at sale time? And do operations-team entitlement relationships reuse the guest relationship graph or are they modelled on the principal in identity - which contract owns the join?
why_it_matters: A family ticket sold against one composition and admitted against another is a gate refusal the guest cannot resolve.

title: Decide the rental advance-booking window fields
question: Define the rental availability fields: minimum advance booking time, maximum advance booking window, last-minute booking cutoff (minutes before the slot) and whether same-day booking is allowed - and whether each is set per product, per category or per location.
why_it_matters: RentalAvailabilityRules carries none of them, so BO-516 cannot be configured and the guest-facing availability cannot be bounded.

title: Decide the reschedule and date-change policy
question: How is the allowed reschedule window expressed (offset days before and after the booked date) and which record configures it; where is the per-ticket date-change count held - the order line or the entitlement - and what happens on the attempt that exceeds the cap?
why_it_matters: rescheduleOrder enforces nothing today, so the cap and the window are promises the API cannot keep.

title: Decide the supplier contract status and its expiring-soon window
question: Fix the supplier-contract status vocabulary (Draft, Active, Expiring Soon, Expired), the days-before-expiry that make a contract Expiring Soon, whether the status is stored or derived, and add the contract-expiry metric to MetricSource with the warning horizon and the recipients of the alert.
why_it_matters: The Key Alert for contracts expiring in 30 days has no metric to watch and no stored horizon.

title: Decide the table definition: capacity bands and the type taxonomy
question: Does a table carry minimum, standard and maximum covers or one capacity plus combination rules, and how do seating rules use each? Fix the table-type taxonomy (Standard, High Top, Large, VIP), say whether it is distinct from shape, and name what it drives - pricing, eligibility or minimum spend.
why_it_matters: TableDefinition.capacity is a single integer and shape is a different axis, so seating rules cannot be expressed.

title: Decide the table-assignment rule for QR orders and waitlist parties
question: Does automatic table assignment happen for QR ordering, and if so does it key on the scanned table code, capacity, section or the waitlist, and what happens when no table matches? And what rule suggests a table for a waitlist party (capacity fit, seating preference, projected free time) - is the suggestion advisory or does it hold the table?
why_it_matters: Both flows promise an assignment the build has no rule for, and a suggestion that silently holds inventory behaves very differently from one that does not.

title: Decide the version-currency and update classification for workstations
question: What makes a deployed software version Latest, Older Version, Outdated or Unknown (versions behind, age since release, or minimumPreviousVersion) and where is it computed? And what update classification does DeviceFirmware carry (routine / critical / security patch, and whether it is mandatory) - which defines what makes a workstation count as requiring an update.
why_it_matters: The Pending Updates panel counts three categories against a firmware record that classifies nothing.

title: Decide the virtual queue target wait time and the lane reallocation trigger
question: Is a target wait time a configurable queue rule, at what scope, and what does the system do when the estimate exceeds it (alert, pause joins, open a lane, adjust the cycle)? And what triggers a reallocation of capacity between lanes (imbalance threshold, observed wait gap, time window), by how much may the split move within what floor and ceiling, and is the change automatic or a recommendation an operator accepts?
why_it_matters: An automatic reallocation with no floor can starve a lane that guests have already been promised.

title: Decide the warehouse alert-type set and the metric behind each
question: Fix the warehouse alert types (Low Stock, Expiry, Negative Stock, Temperature, Overstock, PO Delay, Count Variance, Batch Blocked) and add a MetricSource member for each so an AlertRule can watch it; and decide whether store inventory synchronisation is modelled as a run with a status (as workforce.WorkforceSyncRun is) and whether its failure becomes a MetricSource value or a direct alert emission.
why_it_matters: Eight alert types are listed against a closed MetricSource that names none of them, so no warehouse alert can be configured.

title: Decide when a stock transfer is overdue
question: What sets a transfer's expected arrival - a fixed transit time per location pair, a per-transfer due date, or a supplier lead time - where is that value configured, and at what threshold and severity does an in-transit transfer past that date raise an alert stating by how long it is late?
why_it_matters: Two modules raise the same delayed-transfer alert and neither has an expected-arrival field to compare against.

title: Decide where tax treatment is configured
question: Is the tax base a property of the tax rule or of the calculation sequence - name the two options (gross versus net of discount) and fix which jurisdictions take which - and does a default inclusive/exclusive tax handling sit at tenant, region or price-list level, with what a product that states no treatment inherits?
why_it_matters: Tax computed on the wrong base is a compliance exposure, and two regions cannot be supported until the base is a stored property.

title: Decide whether a product variant combination can be excluded
question: Is an invalid property combination excluded before generation or generated and marked - if the latter, add the third state so a combination can be Active, Disabled or Excluded - and can a combination be added outside the axis product, or does the screen's Add Combination map onto editing the axes?
why_it_matters: ProductVariant.isActive is a boolean, so Disabled and Excluded are indistinguishable and the matrix legend cannot be drawn.

title: Decide whether a safe or vault is a modelled container
question: Is a safe an object (id, code, venue, custodian, capacity, its own balance, count and close-out) that a safe drop selects as a destination and that reconciles like a deposit box, or does it stay a reason and a free-text reference on the withdrawal - and what reconciles it at end of day?
why_it_matters: withdrawFromDepositBox records safeDrop as a reason with a free-text reference, so cash leaving a till is not traceable to anything at end of day.
modules: Cash Management, Cash Management & Till Control

title: Decide whether an approval can be sent back for changes
question: Is a send-back-for-changes outcome added to ApprovalDecision, and what does it do to the request state - back to draft, or a new awaiting-peer round? The same question covers a refund request returned to the guest for more information, including who may set it and what an auto-deny rule evaluates.
why_it_matters: Two screens offer a Request Changes action with no decision value and no target state, so the queue cannot be modelled.

title: Decide whether stock transfer and goods receipt carry a lifecycle
question: Does a transfer have a pre-dispatch lifecycle (Pending, Picked, then Dispatched, In Transit, Received) and if so what reserves stock at pick time and which operation makes each move? Does a goods receipt get a status enum plus a states/ machine (Receiving, Verified, Put Away), and at which state does stock become available and the accrual post?
why_it_matters: Stock becoming available at the wrong state either oversells or understates inventory for the whole receiving window.

title: Decide whether supplier categories are a first-class mapping
question: Is supplier-to-category a mapping table (supplier x category with its own status, sub-category, primary items and certifications) or is it derived from the items a supplier is preferred for - and are certifications held on the mapping or on the supplier document register?
why_it_matters: The Categories Supplied table and the Add Category action have no row to write, and category-scoped sourcing cannot be filtered.

title: Decide whether the commerce journey is its own entity
question: Is a commerce journey a separate entity from the marketing Journey, which inventory source may it name and may it differ from the venue's single source, and what is the fulfilment-method value set (click and collect, shop and drop, delivery, immediate) and which entity declares it?
why_it_matters: marketing-crm.Journey has neither property, so an omnichannel journey cannot be configured at all.

title: Define the F&B margin bridge stages
question: Fix the margin-bridge stages as an ordered measure set (gross sales, discounts, refunds, net revenue, food cost, waste, contribution margin), and decide which two figures the bridge header shows and what its View Full Report link opens.
why_it_matters: A bridge whose stages are not an ordered, named measure set cannot be totalled or reconciled to the P&L.

title: Define the four commercial performance measures
question: Define negotiation success rate (what counts as a negotiation and as success), average discount achieved (against list, quote or previous price), contract renewal rate and supplier retention rate (the window and the denominator), register them in MetricSource, and settle the per-category breakdown that reads them.
why_it_matters: Four gauge tiles quote rates that MetricSource does not name, so nothing populates the Commercial Performance dashboard.

title: Define the purchase-limit model and its scopes
question: Fix the Limit Scope vocabulary (Per Order, Per Guest, Per Account, Per Household, Per Payment Instrument) - what resolves a household (wallet.shared_wallet kind=household is the only candidate) and what identifies a payment instrument across orders without storing a PAN - and decide where a per-transaction quantity cap lives (a new StoreRule kind or a catalogue purchaseEligibility maximum), its default, and whether a breach blocks or escalates.
why_it_matters: Per-household and per-instrument limits have no identifier to key on, so two of the five scopes are unimplementable as written.

title: Define the service level and safety stock measures
question: Is parLevel the safety stock or is a separate field needed; define the service level measure (fill rate, OTIF or cycle service level), its calculation window and grain, register it in MetricSource, and decide its retention - a monthly snapshot or recomputation from movements - so the trend can be drawn.
why_it_matters: The screen reports Avg Service Level and Below Safety Stock against fields and a measure that do not exist.

title: Define the store refund-value baseline and its alert deviation
question: Add a per-outlet refund-value or refund-rate metric to MetricSource, define the 'normal' baseline (rolling mean, same weekday, or budget), and fix the deviation percentage that raises the alert together with the KpiTarget amberAt and redAt per store.
why_it_matters: Two agents raised the same alert; with no baseline the deviation percentage on the alert text is not computable.

title: Define the supplier concentration measure and its bands
question: Fix the concentration measure: the ranking bands (Top 3 / Top 5 / Top 10, and the Top 3 / 4-10 / 11-20 / Others cut for the distribution donut), the denominator (total spend or contracted spend), the period, and whether it lands as a KpiDefinition formula over the semantic model.
why_it_matters: MetricSource has no supplier-concentration member and the bucket edges have no home, so the panel and the donut cannot agree.

title: Fix the RFQ lifecycle and whether an RFQ is a first-class resource
question: Decide the RFQ status vocabulary (Draft, Open, Under Evaluation / Evaluating, Awarded, Closed) - one list for both the pipeline donut and the status field - their transitions, and whether an RFQ is its own resource or a view over requisition plus quotation.
why_it_matters: Two screens use two different stage lists for the same object, so the pipeline counts cannot be reconciled.

title: Fix the capacity hierarchy levels and their precedence
question: Fix the capacity levels (global, venue, attraction, product, variant, date, timeslot), their precedence order, how an effective limit is computed when several apply, and whether the effective limit reports its originating level.
why_it_matters: Two subsystems computing the effective limit in a different order will sell past a limit the other believes is binding.

title: Fix the procurement spend dimensions: spend category and business unit
question: Fix the spend category taxonomy (F&B Ingredients, Beverages, Retail Merchandise, Equipment & Parts, Packaging & Consumables, Others) and the business-unit set (F&B, Retail, Operations, Maintenance, Others); say whether each is tenant-configurable or platform-fixed, where the business unit is held (a tenancy scope node, a cost centre on the requisition, or a procurement dimension table) and which field on the purchase order or requisition carries it.
why_it_matters: PurchaseOrder carries no business unit or category dimension, so spend cannot be cut the way every procurement dashboard cuts it.

title: Fix the resource and labour cost breakdown taxonomies
question: Reconcile the resource cost slices (Labor, Overtime, Maintenance, Rental, External, Other against BO-945's transfer, asset operating and replacement costs) and the labour pay components (Regular Pay, Overtime, Premium Shifts, Allowances, Other); name the ledger account or source that feeds each slice, and decide whether pay components are a groupBy value on getLabourCost or a components[] array on LabourCostRow.
why_it_matters: Two cost donuts would split the same spend differently, and neither has a stated source per slice.

title: Fix the supplier status vocabulary and its blocking effects
question: Decide the supplier lifecycle states (Active, Inactive, Under Evaluation, Blocked, and the Approved/Preferred classification the tabs use), which of them block quotation, purchase order and receipt, add a SupplierStatus enum with a states/supplier.yaml transition model, and add the filter parameter to listSuppliers.
why_it_matters: Supplier.isActive is a boolean, so 'Blocked' cannot be distinguished from 'Inactive' and nothing stops a PO to a blocked supplier.

title: Settle one evaluation order across price lists, promotions and store rules
question: Does StoreRule gain a numeric priority, and what single evaluation order governs price lists, promotions and store rules so that a priority number means the same thing everywhere? Then decide how a day-of-week surcharge is expressed - a dated price list with a priority, a fee on the tax/fee model, or a promotion with a negative discount - and who may publish it.
why_it_matters: Three rule families currently carry their own precedence field; without one order the price a guest is quoted depends on evaluation accident.

title: Decide the camp and recurring-day session treatment
question: Fix the start-date rule vocabulary (fixed date, offset from purchase, guest-selected week) and where the guest's choice is recorded, and decide whether a missed camp session is forfeited, made up or refunded - which requires saying whether sessions are tracked individually rather than as an entry count.
why_it_matters: Tracking sessions individually rather than as a counter is a data-model change that cannot be retrofitted once camps are sold.

title: Decide the clone model for products and validity rules
question: Do entitlement templates get a clone operation following copyPriceList, and what does a clone do about the products that referenced the original? And how does a bulk clone name its clones - a code pattern, a suffix, or a per-row prompt - given cloneProduct requires a unique code per clone?
why_it_matters: A bulk clone action with no naming rule cannot be executed at all against a unique-code constraint.

title: Decide the delivery retry policy and whether the next attempt is stored
question: Do ticket-delivery retries follow the platform's exponential backoff (ADR-0033) or need their own configurable fixed interval, and if the latter where is it set; and is the next retry time stored as a nextAttemptAt on DeadLetter/WebhookDelivery or computed by the reader from lastAttemptAt plus the backoff curve?
why_it_matters: Two screens show a retry interval and a next retry time that neither the contract nor the ADR currently exposes.

title: Decide the group entry rules: entry window and minimum presence
question: Does a group have a bounded entry window - its length, whether it runs from the first scan, and what happens to late members - and must a minimum share of the group be present before any of it is admitted, at what percentage, with what happening to the rest?
why_it_matters: Both are gate-refusal rules; without values the gate cannot be configured and a group refused entry has no stated basis.

title: Decide the point-of-sale receipt and guest-identification defaults
question: Where does the default receipt delivery method live (tenant, venue or workstation), what is its value set (print, email, both, none) and may a guest choice override it? And is guest identification at the point of sale optional, required, required above a threshold or skipped - at what scope is it set and what may a cashier override?
why_it_matters: Both are per-sale behaviours with no home, so two workstations in the same venue would behave differently with no way to say which is right.

title: Decide the waitlist eligibility and cap
question: Where is waitlist eligibility held - product, variant or performance - and what is the default for products that say nothing; is the waitlist capped, at what level is the cap configured, and what does joinWaitlist return once it is full?
why_it_matters: An uncapped waitlist with no eligibility default means every product silently accepts waitlist joins.

title: Decide where the guest-facing rule message is authored and localised
question: For a sold-out product and for a purchase limit reached, where is the customer message authored and at what scope does it resolve - a product-level override, a tenant content block, per channel or per rule - is it localised through LocalisedText, and does it replace or supplement the Problem.detail the API returns?
why_it_matters: Two guest-facing refusal messages are configurable on the screens and nothing stores them, so the guest would see a raw API problem.

title: Decide whether OfflinePolicy carries a lifecycle
question: Does OfflinePolicy carry a status (draft / active / superseded) like ConfigurationProfile so a policy can be staged, edited and disabled, or is it always the single live row for its scope and writing it is immediate?
why_it_matters: Two screens display an Active status and an Edit Policy action against a schema with no status field.

title: Decide whether dataTable gains a totals and averages footer
question: Does the dataTable component gain a totals/averages footer row, which columns sum and which average, and is the footer computed server-side over the whole population or only over the loaded page?
why_it_matters: A footer computed over the loaded page only would silently misreport estate totals under pagination.

title: Decide whether performance capacity supports bulk edit
question: Does performance capacity support a multi-select bulk edit, what may be selected by (performance, date range, event, envelope), and does the bulk change apply to envelope capacity, channel allocations or both?
why_it_matters: A bulk change that silently rewrites channel allocations could oversell every affected performance at once.

title: Decide whether realised rental revenue appears on the availability view
question: Does realised revenue appear as a tile on BO-514/BO-518 alongside inventory status, or stay in BO-585 with a drill-down - and if it appears, name the measure (realised rental revenue per product per period).
why_it_matters: The same figure on two screens computed two ways would not tie out.

title: Decide whether recipe ingredients carry a yield percentage
question: Is a per-ingredient yield percentage added to Recipe.ingredients, how does it interact with the recipe-level yield, and is costPerPortion computed gross or net of it?
why_it_matters: Gross versus net yield changes every portion cost and therefore every margin figure downstream.

title: Decide whether revenue allocation supports fixed-amount splits
question: Does revenue allocation support fixed-amount splits alongside percentage, and if so what is the split rule shape (basis, rounding, residual handling) on the finance contract?
why_it_matters: Rounding and residual handling on a split is the difference between a balanced and an unbalanced allocation.

title: Decide whether the 3D section view is in scope
question: Is the 3D view-from-seat in scope, and if so what produces it (an uploaded CAD model, a generated mesh or third-party imagery), which surfaces show it, and what is the fallback for a venue with no model?
why_it_matters: A per-venue 3D model is a content pipeline, not a feature toggle, and the fallback decides whether the flow works at all.

title: Decide whether the catalogue emits a productUpdated event
question: Does the catalogue emit a productUpdated event distinct from productPublished, and is pricing a registered consumer - both are entries in events/ with an idempotency key and an onFailure policy.
why_it_matters: Pricing reacting to an event that is not emitted means a price never refreshes after a product change.

title: Decide whether the date picker gains a horizontal near-term variant
question: Does the date picker gain a horizontal near-term variant, how many days does it show before the full calendar takes over, and is the choice per tenant or fixed?
why_it_matters: A second picker variant doubles the availability-fetch pattern on the guest storefront.

title: Decide whether the sync queue exposes an in-flight state
question: Does the offline sync queue expose an in-flight state distinct from pending, and what happens to an in-flight item if the connection drops mid-replay?
why_it_matters: Without an in-flight state a replay interrupted mid-flight can double-post or vanish.

title: Decide whether the terminal reports its local storage use
question: Does the offline bundle report a size per data class, and does the terminal report its local storage use at all?
why_it_matters: The Cache Details table reports a size per data type that nothing measures.

title: Define outlet production risk
question: What does production risk measure - shortfall against plan, ingredient cover, staffing - and what are the thresholds for Low, Medium and High?
why_it_matters: Neither ProductionRun nor ProductionPlan carries a risk measure, so the outlet health table cannot fill the column.
